page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m2.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual server belonging to the ecs.s6 server family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance features 8 vCPUs with a shared CPU allocation model and is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type operates on the KVM hypervisor. It does not include any bundled local storage or dedicated graphics processing units. Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Due to the shared CPU allocation model, this instance is positioned as a cost-efficient option for workloads that do not require continuous, dedicated CPU performance. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it suitable for entry-level compute tasks, lightweight web serving, development environments, and non-critical background processes where resource sharing is acceptable.
